mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipts ( user_id, trip_id, country_id, category_id, currency_id, payment_datetime, file_name, file_url, file_type, memo, status, merchant_original_name, merchant_translated_name, total_amount, ocr_raw_text, split_count, error_message, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tripId}, #{countryId}, #{categoryId}, #{currencyId}, #{paymentDateTime}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileType}, #{memo}, #{status}, #{merchantOriginalName}, #{merchantTranslatedName}, #{totalAmount}, #{ocrRawText}, #{splitCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{processedAt} )

INSERT INTO receipt_items ( receipt_id, original_name, translated_name, quantity, amount, display_order ) VALUES
( #{item.receiptId}, #{item.originalName}, #{item.translatedName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.amount}, #{item.displayOrder} )

INSERT INTO receipt_participants ( receipt_id, participant_name, display_order ) VALUES
( #{participant.receiptId}, #{participant.participantName}, #{participant.displayOrder} )
mapper.select:
SELECT receipt.id, receipt.trip_id,
receipt.country_id, country.country_name,
receipt.category_id, category.category_name,
receipt.merchant_original_name, receipt.merchant_translated_name, receipt.payment_datetime,
currency.currency_code, currency.symbol AS currency_symbol,
receipt.total_amount, receipt.split_count, receipt.file_url FROM receipts receipt INNER JOIN countries country ON country.id = receipt.country_id INNER JOIN spending_categories category ON category.id = receipt.category_id LEFT JOIN currencies currency ON currency.id = receipt.currency_id WHERE receipt.user_id = #{userId} AND receipt.trip_id = #{tripId} AND receipt.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY receipt.payment_datetime DESC, receipt.id DESC

SELECT receipt.id, receipt.trip_id,
receipt.country_id, country.country_name,
receipt.category_id, category.category_name,
receipt.currency_id, currency.currency_code, currency.currency_name, currency.symbol AS currency_symbol,
receipt.payment_datetime, receipt.file_name, receipt.file_url, receipt.file_type, receipt.memo, receipt.status,
receipt.merchant_original_name, receipt.merchant_translated_name,
receipt.total_amount, receipt.split_count, receipt.ocr_raw_text,
receipt.created_at, receipt.updated_at FROM receipts receipt INNER JOIN countries country ON country.id = receipt.country_id INNER JOIN spending_categories category ON category.id = receipt.category_id LEFT JOIN currencies currency ON currency.id = receipt.currency_id WHERE receipt.id = #{receiptId} AND receipt.user_id = #{userId} AND receipt.trip_id = #{tripId} AND receipt.is_deleted = 0

SELECT item.id, item.receipt_id, item.original_name, item.translated_name, item.quantity, item.amount, item.display_order, item.is_deleted, item.deleted_at, item.created_at, item.updated_at FROM receipt_items item INNER JOIN receipts receipt ON receipt.id = item.receipt_id WHERE item.receipt_id = #{receiptId} AND receipt.user_id = #{userId} AND receipt.trip_id = #{tripId} AND receipt.is_deleted = 0 AND item.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY item.display_order ASC, item.id ASC

SELECT participant.id, participant.receipt_id, participant.participant_name, participant.display_order, participant.is_deleted, participant.deleted_at, participant.created_at, participant.updated_at FROM receipt_participants participant INNER JOIN receipts receipt ON receipt.id = participant.receipt_id WHERE participant.receipt_id = #{receiptId} AND receipt.user_id = #{userId} AND receipt.trip_id = #{tripId} AND receipt.is_deleted = 0 AND participant.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY participant.display_order ASC, participant.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE receipts SET trip_id = #{tripId}, country_id = #{countryId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, currency_id = #{currencyId}, payment_datetime = #{paymentDateTime}, memo = #{memo}, merchant_original_name = #{merchantOriginalName}, merchant_translated_name = #{merchantTranslatedName}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, ocr_raw_text = #{ocrRawText}, split_count = #{splitCount} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0
